productName: Melissa & Doug My First Daily Magnetic Calendar
chokingHazardAssessment: The set includes 84 small wooden magnetic pieces. The retailer labels it for ages 3 and older. Small magnetic pieces carry two distinct risks: choking, and serious internal injury if more than one magnet is swallowed. SafeNest has not physically measured the pieces or tested magnet retention. Keep the set away from children who still mouth objects, and check after each use that no pieces are missing.
pros: Gives an abstract idea — today's date, the weather — something to touch
Two hinged boards mean the magnets store where they are used
Doubles as a morning routine anchor for a homeschool day
Dry-erase side allows your own layout
cons: Many small magnetic pieces; a missing one is worth finding
Magnet strength weakens with heavy handling over time
Amazon's listing states ages 4 and up while the retailer page says 3 and up, so treat the packaging in your hand as authoritative
